about:
ProTronics Inc. operates from Knightdale, North Carolina. The company has over 31 years of experience in printed circuit board assembly and design, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not stated.

The company provides a full suite of electronics manufacturing services, including PCB design, assembly (surface mount and through-hole), testing, rework and repair, IC packaging, cable assembly, and turnkey box builds. It also offers product development, new product introduction, BOM analysis, and certification management. Quality control includes 100% inspection to IPC-A-610 Class 2 and 3 criteria, using X-ray and semi-automated optical inspection for BGA and lead-less devices. Environmental testing capabilities cover ambient functional testing and ESS with hot-cold cycling and humidity. No facility size or employee count is disclosed.

ProTronics serves commercial, military, and medical electronics sectors. Its customer base includes companies such as Honeywell, MTS, Cisco Systems, Vishay Micro-Measurements, Cadence, Schneider Electric, NetApp, and academic partners like North Carolina State University. Projects have ranged from circuit boards for golf balls to implantable medical devices.

The company highlights its quick turnaround, competitive pricing, and advanced technology as differentiators. It also notes ITAR registration and RoHS compliance for regulated work.
